speaker: consultant
text: Hello, this is Elena Ward.

speaker: customer
text: Elena, it is Priya Sharma. I have to be honest, I am quite frustrated right now.

speaker: consultant
text: I am sorry to hear that, Priya. Please tell me what happened.

speaker: customer
text: We had our kickoff session nine days ago. You said I would get the action plan within five business days. I still have nothing.

speaker: consultant
text: You are right, and I apologize. That is my mistake. The plan should have reached you last Thursday.

speaker: customer
text: I told my business partner we would have it this week. Now I look unprepared.

speaker: consultant
text: I understand, and that is not the experience I want you to have. Can I explain what happened, and then tell you how I will fix it?

speaker: customer
text: Fine. Go ahead.

speaker: consultant
text: The plan was finished, but it was sent to an old email address from your questionnaire. I should have checked that it arrived. That is on me.

speaker: customer
text: An old address? Which one?

speaker: consultant
text: The one ending in old studio dot com.

speaker: customer
text: Oh, I did write that by accident. But you still should have noticed I never replied.

speaker: consultant
text: Absolutely. Here is what I will do. I will send the plan to your current address within the next hour, and I will call you to confirm it arrived.

speaker: customer
text: Okay, that helps.

speaker: consultant
text: And because of the delay, I would like to add one extra session to your package at no cost. We can use it with your business partner, so we can walk through the plan together.

speaker: customer
text: That is actually a good idea. He has a lot of questions about the budget part.

speaker: consultant
text: Perfect. Would next Tuesday at two in the afternoon work for both of you?

speaker: customer
text: Let me check. Yes, Tuesday at two works.

speaker: consultant
text: Great. I will send the calendar invite together with the plan.

speaker: customer
text: Alright. Thank you for owning the mistake, Elena. I appreciate it.

speaker: consultant
text: Thank you for telling me directly, Priya. You will have the plan within the hour.
